rows.headline: The Exchange has sought clarification from Infobeans Technologies Ltd on October 12, 2026, with reference to Movement in Volume. The reply is awaited.
rows.subject: Clarification sought from Infobeans Technologies Ltd
rows.title: The Exchange has sought clarification from Infobeans Technologies Ltd on October 12, 2026, with reference to Movement in Volume. The reply is awaited.
Spurt in Volume
rows.summary: Significant increase in volume has been observed in InfoBeans Techno. Ltd.. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. InfoBeans Techno. Ltd. has submitted their response.
